events.event_name: Max Mara Le Parfum × Macy’s Sampling
events.address: Macy’s Herald Square Plaza, 151 West 34th Street, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: An open-air launch pop-up for Max Mara Le Parfum with an interactive scent experience, games and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary gelato and fragrance samples; giveaways are offered while supplies last.
events.caveats: The organizer's Eventbrite page confirms the event, address and 10 AM–6 PM hours but does not state that an Eventbrite ticket provides special access. Current event listings describe it as open to the public. Treat as walk-in rather than implying ticketed priority.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM–6 PM at Macy’s Herald Square Plaza. Samples, gelato and giveaways are while supplies last.

events.what_it_is: A two-day reopening celebration for Credo Beauty's SoHo boutique with gifts and product raffles.
events.what_is_free: First 150 guests each day receive a complimentary gift with no purchase necessary; no-purchase product raffles are also advertised. A separate gift with $100 purchase is purchase-gated.
events.caveats: RSVP is advertised but explicitly not required and does not guarantee gift eligibility. Free gifts are first-come, first-served and limited to the first 150 guests each day. The $100 gift-with-purchase is separate.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 19: 11 AM–7 PM. Sept. 20: 11 AM–6 PM. 9 Prince Street.

events.what_it_is: A two-day Korean-dabang-inspired cafe pop-up created by Oatly and Korean-American artist/producer Yaeji.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary iced Gochujang Lattes made with espresso, Oatly Barista Edition, gochujang-vanilla base and salted vanilla cold foam.
events.caveats: Two current sources agree on the address, dates, daily hours and complimentary latte offer. No advance RSVP requirement is published; availability is naturally limited by event capacity/supplies.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 19–20, 9 AM–3 PM each day at 48 Ludlow Street.

events.address: 315C Park Avenue South, New York, NY 10010
events.what_it_is: Opening-weekend celebration for Tatte's first New York City cafe, with drinks, live illustration, bouquets and special-edition merchandise.
events.what_is_free: Matcha and Pistachio Rose Lattes with Táche, live illustrations and build-your-own bouquets are advertised as treats for guests; special-edition merchandise is first-come, first-served.
events.caveats: The event listing says the celebration starts at 8 AM each day and runs until the promotional items run out; do not infer a fixed ending time. Tatte's official location page independently confirms the new Gramercy cafe and address.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 19 and Sept. 20, starting 8 AM each day, while promotional supplies last.

events.event_name: La Mer Ice Cream at Bloomingdale’s SoHo
events.address: Bloomingdale’s SoHo, 504 Broadway, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: A La Mer beauty activation at Bloomingdale’s SoHo tied to the reformulated Concentrate.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary ice cream plus a personalized Skin by La Mer experience and complimentary sample of the new Concentrate.
events.caveats: Bloomingdale's corporate announcement confirms La Mer ice cream-cart activations on Sept. 19; current NYC event sources identify the SoHo location and 2–6 PM window. Treat samples/treats as while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 2–6 PM at Bloomingdale’s SoHo, 504 Broadway.

events.event_name: Insta360 Times Square Flagship Grand Opening
events.what_it_is: Grand opening of Insta360's Times Square flagship store with camera demos, giveaways, opening-day discounts and NYC-exclusive merchandise.
events.what_is_free: Entry and product demos are free. Opening-day promotions include giveaways/lucky-draw opportunities; some free accessories require qualifying camera purchases.
events.caveats: Insta360's current social post independently confirms the Sept. 19 grand opening and 1515 Broadway address. The event listing advertises sign-up for opening-day participation/prize opportunities; purchase-gated accessory offers are not represented as unconditional freebies.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, noon–5 PM. Sign-up is the advertised participation path for opening-day perks.
